name: mimo-skill-creator
title_zh: 给 MiMo Code 造 Skill 的质检台
tagline_zh: 写 Skill 最怕触发词不灵、描述白搭。这个工具能本地跑测试、查触发、打包 .skill。
tagline_en: Tired of skills that never trigger? Test, verify, and package .skill files locally before shipping—catch dead.
desc_en: Create, test, and optimize skills for MiMo Code. Use when creating a skill, editing one, testing if a skill works, optimizing skill triggering, or packaging a .skill file. Triggers: "create skill", "new skill", "edit skill", "test skill", "skill not triggering", "optimize description", "package skill", "verify skill", "skill ready to ship". NOT for: CLAUDE.md rules, one-off prompts, project conven
why_zh: 它把「写描述」和「验触发」焊在一起：改完 description 立刻跑一遍匹配测试。
why_en: Welds description editing to trigger verification—every tweak gets an instant match test, so you hear whether your skill.
limit_zh: 只服务 MiMo Code 生态，不认 Claude 或别家 Agent 的 skill 格式。
limit_en: MiMo Code only—no Claude or other agent skill formats. Won't handle CLAUDE.md rules, one-off prompts, or project configs. Output ends at .skill.
title_en: Skill workbench for MiMo Code: create, test, package
